publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4, build 4A102; original iPod reference and native PinePhone research
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.

record.title: USB power balance changes with the workload
record.method: Read-only AXP803 samples grouped by observed display state
record.observation: At the recorded 500 mA nominal USB input limit, the initial bright lock screen drew a median 55 mA from the battery. Blanked idle supplied a median 166 mA to the battery; brief wake windows had a positive median balance. The original power-source service also published real battery state.
record.limits: These are battery-side net measurements from bounded windows, not USB input current or whole-system watts. Continuous heavy UI use, battery life, native thermal monitoring and system suspend are unvalidated. PMIC configuration and CPU clocks were unchanged.

records.access: Private project record; only the selected excerpt is distributed

exhibits.title: USB power balance changes with the workload
exhibits.interpretation: Positive values charge the battery. A USB cable or charging icon does not imply a positive battery balance during every workload.
